greet.speaker: Arena Duelist
greet.text: A rapier flashes in a mock salute. "Round one. Try to make it interesting."
greet.text_zh: 一柄細劍閃現，做出模擬敬禮的動作。「第一回合。試著讓我覺得有趣一點。」

already_won.speaker: Arena Duelist
already_won.text: "Go on, the gate's open for you. Try not to get cocky in there."
already_won.text_zh: 「去吧，門為你開了。到裡面別太得意忘形。」
